timeline: Walk the home together, set the plan and the price range. Book trades now — good painters and handymen fill up. Start decluttering the rooms you use least, and order a pre-listing inspection if we agree it makes sense.
Repairs, paint and touch-ups. Deep clean begins. Pack up what you won't need until after the move. Gather paperwork: warranties, receipts for updates, utility costs, survey.
Finish projects. Windows, carpets and the final deep clean. Curb appeal: mulch, edges, front door, porch light. Fill out your Seller's Disclosure with me.
Every light on, blinds open, counters clear, cars out of the driveway, pets and pet things put away. Toilet lids down. I'll walk through with you an hour before.
Lights on, temperature comfortable, quick tidy, out of the house with your pets. Valuables, medications and mail put away. Feedback comes to you on your seller page.
